finalText:
Build now finishes clean (exit 0). The rest of the wall of text was harmless deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) from the bumped bundler — real problem was two link-stage bugs from its options-shape change:

- `src/core/options.js`: bundler now passes `{ retryCount }`, not `{ retries }` — was reading the wrong key and crashing on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Now treats anything but `true` as disabled.
